ask: Which words should the new langquest.org homepage use?
problem: The homepage still describes the old LangQuest. It talks about projects, AI translation, points and rewards, and phone-to-phone sharing that is not built. It never mentions the new app.
found: The page text and the sections were written for the first LangQuest. The new app is about recording Bible passages by voice, checking them with a team, and working offline for weeks. The page also had no link to the web app.
changed: The top of the page now says what the new app does and has an Open the web app button. The old sections are replaced by four features, three steps, and three team roles. The coming-soon sharing section is gone. Other languages show English words until they are translated. The link to the old portal stays, with a new title.
why: I wrote the words from what the app does today. I could not read the LAN-219 plan, so please check it against this page. I kept the app store buttons, but they may point to the old listing.
touches: Only the homepage and how it picks words for other languages. Spanish, French, Indonesian, Portuguese, Tok Pisin and Chinese still need translations of the new words.

options.label: A: Plain and new
options.result: The page speaks only about the new app. Headline: Record Bible translations in your own language.

options.label: B: Keep the old headline
options.result: The page keeps Translate, Preserve, and Connect and says LangQuest Next is the new LangQuest.
